name: Summit AZ - Blog Water Softener Maintenance Checklist 2026-09-26
body:
> Blog · Summit Az · 2026-09-26

# Summary
Supporting blog B3: "Water Softener Maintenance Checklist for Hard Arizona Water" (about 1,500 words). Saved in WordPress as post 11525 with featured image 11526 (Higgsfield photo plus the standard Summit banner). The Oct 1 handoff lists it as published Sep 25 at `/blog/water-softener-maintenance-checklist/`.

# Keywords (Search Atlas project 5028616)
- Focus: "water softener maintenance" 14,800 / KD 25.
- Secondary: "salt bridge water softener" 4,400 / KD 22 (own H2), "water softener regeneration frequency" 590 / KD 25, "how often to add salt to water softener" 260 / KD 15.
- "water softener maintenance arizona" is used only as a local modifier in the title and H1.

# Cannibalization handling
- `/water-softeners/` already owns the service version and the "water softener maintenance arizona" Rank Math keyword, so the post is an owner how-to, its slug and focus keyword avoid "arizona" and "near me", and it sends service intent to `/water-softeners/` with a "repair and maintenance" anchor.

# Content
- Short answer up front: check salt monthly, break up salt bridges, match the hardness setting, yearly check.
- Only outside facts are from the City of Mesa water quality page (12 to 22 gpg, gpg as the setting unit, sodium rise per grain, irrigation upstream of the softener).
- Hub: `/blog/are-water-softeners-worth-it/`. Money pages: `/water-softeners/`, then `/plumbing-maintenance/`.

# Decisions and status
- Early check Oct 5: the new post had 16 impressions and "water softener maintenance checklist" at position 6.4 (see [Summit AZ - Early Performance Check 2026-10-05](lib:brain-summit-az-early-performance-check-2026-10-05)).
